title: 資源回收廠光學分選~Optical sorting in materials recovery facilities
focus: 光譜辨識、噴嘴時序與回收品質~Spectral recognition, ejector timing and recovery quality
summary: 以「光譜辨識、噴嘴時序與回收品質」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow spectral recognition, ejector timing and recovery quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 物料組成與目標~Feed composition and target
units.mechanism: 先定義欲回收物與污染物，純度和回收率才有明確分母。~Define target and contaminant classes before calculating purity and recovery.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.3；計算 1000*0.3 = 300 kg/h。適用限制：單一目標聚合物的假想進料。~Original hypothetical teaching example: target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.3; calculation 1000*0.3 = 300 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical feed for one target polymer.
units.verify: 把進料中PET比例改變，觀察分母。~Vary feed PET fraction and track denominators.
units.failure: 以總進料作回收率分母會混同產率。~Using total feed as recovery denominator confuses yield.
units.misconception: 產品質量除總進料就是目標物回收率。~Product mass divided by total feed is target recovery.
units.practice: 在「物料組成與目標」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 300 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以總進料作回收率分母會混同產率。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for feed composition and target, first reproduce 300 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using total feed as recovery denominator confuses yield." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 單層送料與遮蔽~Monolayer feeding and occlusion
units.mechanism: 相互覆蓋讓下層物料無法被辨識，均勻送料常比單純提高模型複雜度更重要。~Overlapping items hide lower layers; uniform feeding can matter more than classifier complexity.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：visible fraction=uncovered/total;850/1000；計算 850/1000 = 0.85 fraction。適用限制：可視物件數示例。~Original hypothetical teaching example: visible fraction=uncovered/total;850/1000; calculation 850/1000 = 0.85 fraction. Applicability: Illustrative visible object count.
units.verify: 固定相機設定，改變送料厚度比較漏檢。~Keep camera settings and vary bed depth to compare misses.
units.failure: 雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。~Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another.
units.misconception: 演算法可從完全不透明覆蓋下直接看見所有物料。~An algorithm directly sees everything beneath opaque cover.
units.practice: 在「單層送料與遮蔽」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.85 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「雙層物料可能讓光譜代表上件而噴嘴吹走下件。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for monolayer feeding and occlusion, first reproduce 0.85 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Two layers can make spectra identify the upper object while the jet moves another." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 光譜訊噪比~Spectral signal-to-noise ratio
units.mechanism: 材質辨識依光譜特徵與噪音差異，髒污、濕度和表面顏色會改變訊號。~Material recognition depends on spectral features relative to noise; dirt, moisture and colour alter signals.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：SNR=signal/noise;signal=120;noise=6；計算 120/6 = 20 ratio。適用限制：線性振幅比，非分貝。~Original hypothetical teaching example: SNR=signal/noise;signal=120;noise=6; calculation 120/6 = 20 ratio. Applicability: Linear amplitude ratio, not decibels.
units.verify: 量測乾淨和髒污樣本的光譜差異。~Compare spectra of clean and dirty samples.
units.failure: 以訓練時乾燥樣本套用潮濕進料會產生域偏移。~A dry training set can fail on wet feed through domain shift.
units.misconception: 同種塑膠在任何污損狀態都有完全相同光譜。~One plastic has identical spectra under every contamination state.
units.practice: 在「光譜訊噪比」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以訓練時乾燥樣本套用潮濕進料會產生域偏移。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for spectral signal-to-noise ratio, first reproduce 20 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A dry training set can fail on wet feed through domain shift." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 像素與物件尺寸~Pixels and object size
units.mechanism: 空間解析度需能分辨最小欲分選物；相機視野加寬會增加每像素尺寸。~Resolve the minimum target size; widening the field increases millimetres per pixel.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：pixel size=FOV/pixels;1000mm/1000；計算 1000/1000 = 1 mm/pixel。適用限制：正投影中心近似。~Original hypothetical teaching example: pixel size=FOV/pixels;1000mm/1000; calculation 1000/1000 = 1 mm/pixel. Applicability: Central orthographic approximation.
units.verify: 把視野加倍但像素數不變，檢查小物件。~Double field of view at fixed pixels and inspect small objects.
units.failure: 只報相機總像素不提供視野會無法判斷分辨力。~Pixel count without field of view does not establish resolution.
units.misconception: 像素數相同的相機在任何視野都有相同物體解析度。~Equal pixel counts give equal object resolution at any field of view.
units.practice: 在「像素與物件尺寸」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1 mm/pixel，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報相機總像素不提供視野會無法判斷分辨力。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pixels and object size, first reproduce 1 mm/pixel, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Pixel count without field of view does not establish resolution." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 分類精確率~Classification precision
units.mechanism: 精確率衡量被選中者有多少是真目標；需與召回率分開。~Precision measures how many selected items are true targets and differs from recall.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：precision=TP/(TP+FP);TP=90;FP=10；計算 90/(90+10) = 0.9 fraction。適用限制：物件數基準，非質量純度。~Original hypothetical teaching example: precision=TP/(TP+FP);TP=90;FP=10; calculation 90/(90+10) = 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Object-count basis, not mass purity.
units.verify: 加入大質量誤判物，比較計數精確率與質量純度。~Add a heavy false positive and compare count precision with mass purity.
units.failure: 少量重污染物可能嚴重降低質量純度。~A few heavy contaminants can strongly reduce mass purity.
units.misconception: 物件數精確率必定等於產品質量純度。~Count precision always equals product mass purity.
units.practice: 在「分類精確率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.9 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「少量重污染物可能嚴重降低質量純度。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for classification precision, first reproduce 0.9 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A few heavy contaminants can strongly reduce mass purity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 召回率與漏失~Recall and missed recovery
units.mechanism: 召回率以真目標總數為分母；提高閾值常增加純度卻減少回收。~Recall uses all actual targets as denominator; a stricter threshold often increases purity while reducing recovery.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：recall=TP/(TP+FN);TP=90;FN=30；計算 90/(90+30) = 0.75 fraction。適用限制：相同測試批次。~Original hypothetical teaching example: recall=TP/(TP+FN);TP=90;FN=30; calculation 90/(90+30) = 0.75 fraction. Applicability: Same test batch.
units.verify: 繪出三個分類閾值的精確率與召回率。~Plot precision and recall for three thresholds.
units.failure: 只報純度可能掩蓋大量目標流入殘渣。~Purity alone can hide target loss to residue.
units.misconception: 純度提高就代表回收率一定提高。~Higher purity necessarily means higher recovery.
units.practice: 在「召回率與漏失」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.75 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報純度可能掩蓋大量目標流入殘渣。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for recall and missed recovery, first reproduce 0.75 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Purity alone can hide target loss to residue." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 輸送帶與噴嘴延遲~Belt travel and ejector delay
units.mechanism: 辨識位置到噴嘴的輸送時間為距離除帶速；發送命令的等待時間須扣除通訊及閥門響應，確保氣流與物件同時到位。~Transport time is sensing-to-nozzle distance divided by belt speed; subtract communication and valve response from command waiting time so jet and object arrive together.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：command wait=L/v-tcommunication-tvalve;L=1.2m;v=3m/s;delays=0.02s,0.03s；計算 1.2/3-0.02-0.03 = 0.35 s。適用限制：物件不滑動且延遲已校正；等待時間不得為負。~Original hypothetical teaching example: command wait=L/v-tcommunication-tvalve;L=1.2m;v=3m/s;delays=0.02s,0.03s; calculation 1.2/3-0.02-0.03 = 0.35 s. Applicability: No object slip and calibrated delays; command wait cannot be negative.
units.verify: 帶速增加10%，同步調整觸發時間。~Increase belt speed ten percent and update trigger timing.
units.failure: 固定延遲遇到變速會噴錯位置。~Fixed delay during speed changes ejects the wrong position.
units.misconception: 輸送帶變速不需更新噴嘴時序。~Belt speed changes require no ejector timing update.
units.practice: 在「輸送帶與噴嘴延遲」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.35 s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「固定延遲遇到變速會噴錯位置。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for belt travel and ejector delay, first reproduce 0.35 s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Fixed delay during speed changes ejects the wrong position." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 噴嘴解析與氣耗~Jet resolution and air use
units.mechanism: 噴嘴間距與脈寬決定選擇範圍，也會帶走鄰近物；氣耗需按觸發次數估計。~Nozzle spacing and pulse width set the affected region and may entrain neighbors; estimate air by trigger count.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：air volume=flow*pulse*events;0.002m3/s*0.03s*1000；計算 0.002*0.03*1000 = 0.06 m3。適用限制：同一壓力狀態的假想體積。~Original hypothetical teaching example: air volume=flow*pulse*events;0.002m3/s*0.03s*1000; calculation 0.002*0.03*1000 = 0.06 m3. Applicability: Hypothetical volume at one pressure state.
units.verify: 比較單噴嘴與相鄰噴嘴同觸發的夾帶。~Compare entrainment from one versus adjacent jets.
units.failure: 脈寬過長會提高誤帶和壓縮空氣需求。~An overly long pulse increases entrainment and air demand.
units.misconception: 噴嘴脈寬越長就一定分得越精準。~Longer ejector pulses always improve precision.
units.practice: 在「噴嘴解析與氣耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.06 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「脈寬過長會提高誤帶和壓縮空氣需求。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for jet resolution and air use, first reproduce 0.06 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "An overly long pulse increases entrainment and air demand." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 質量收支與抽樣~Mass balance and sampling
units.mechanism: 產品、殘渣與設備滯留需閉合；抽樣要覆蓋整段生產變動。~Close product, residue and holdup mass; sample production variability.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：closure=(product+residue)/feed;(320+670)/1000；計算 (320+670)/1000 = 0.99 fraction。適用限制：缺口包含滯留與量測誤差。~Original hypothetical teaching example: closure=(product+residue)/feed;(320+670)/1000; calculation (320+670)/1000 = 0.99 fraction. Applicability: Gap includes holdup and measurement error.
units.verify: 在不同時段抽樣，不只抓最乾淨一把產品。~Sample multiple times rather than the cleanest handful.
units.failure: 不具代表性樣品會高估全批純度。~Unrepresentative samples overstate batch purity.
units.misconception: 一把乾淨產品足以證明整天產品品質。~One clean handful proves all-day quality.
units.practice: 在「質量收支與抽樣」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.99 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不具代表性樣品會高估全批純度。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for mass balance and sampling, first reproduce 0.99 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Unrepresentative samples overstate batch purity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 模型漂移與人工複核~Model drift and human review
units.mechanism: 包材、顏料和光源老化會改變分類分布；需保留標註、版本與盲測。~Packaging, pigments and lamp aging shift classification; retain labels, versions and blind tests.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：error-rate increase=0.08-0.03；計算 0.08-0.03 = 0.05 fraction points。適用限制：絕對錯誤率差。~Original hypothetical teaching example: error-rate increase=0.08-0.03; calculation 0.08-0.03 = 0.05 fraction points. Applicability: Absolute error-rate difference.
units.verify: 用新包材建立保留測試集並比較版本。~Create a held-out new-packaging set and compare versions.
units.failure: 用同批訓練樣本報性能會高估泛化。~Reporting training-set performance overstates generalization.
units.misconception: AI分選器訓練後永遠不需重新驗證。~An AI sorter never needs revalidation after training.
units.practice: 在「模型漂移與人工複核」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 fraction points，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用同批訓練樣本報性能會高估泛化。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for model drift and human review, first reproduce 0.05 fraction points, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting training-set performance overstates generalization." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
